bootstrap_architecture.stage1: System updates, operator creation, explicit public-key installation, scoped sudoers, Docker CE installation, fail2ban, UFW baseline, DOCKER-USER chain filter, candidate SSH config
bootstrap_architecture.operator_proof: Machine-enforced proof recording (--record-operator-proof) requiring active SSH session as cybrik-admin and recording key fingerprint + session nonce into /opt/cybrik/.operator_ssh_proof
bootstrap_architecture.stage2: Enforces PermitRootLogin no, PasswordAuthentication no, sshd -t syntax test, reload sshd (DENIED if operator proof is absent)
bootstrap_architecture.verify: Independent post-bootstrap check of OS, accounts, sudoers, sshd, Docker, fail2ban, Chrony, UFW, DOCKER-USER, and forbidden ports

operator_privilege_and_auth_model.sudo_model: SCOPED_COMMAND_ALIASES (CYBRIK_INFRA = systemctl, service, ufw, docker, apt-get, journalctl, iptables, /opt/cybrik/bin/*)

threat_model_disclosure.rationale: Docker socket access (/var/run/docker.sock) grants root-equivalent control over the host via container management. Scoped sudoers enforces operational safety and prevents accidental unprivileged misuse.

ssh_hardening_and_root_lockdown.PreLockdownRootBaseline: Verified via real SSH login test (ROOT_SSH_PRE_LOCKDOWN = PASS)
ssh_hardening_and_root_lockdown.PermitRootLogin: no (Applied in Stage 2 after machine-enforced proof)
ssh_hardening_and_root_lockdown.PostLockdownRootDenial: Verified via real SSH connection attempt with same key (ROOT_SSH_POST_LOCKDOWN = DENIED)
ssh_hardening_and_root_lockdown.lockout_guard: Syntax test sshd -t executed before reload; automated rollback on failure

userns-remap.justification: User namespace remapping conflicts with PostgreSQL 16 and Valkey 8 persistent volume UID/GID ownership.

docker_user_chain_protection.bypass_test: Verified via external network namespace simulation

failure_injection_coverage.F4: Malformed sudoers candidate rejected by visudo
failure_injection_coverage.F5: Malformed sshd config rejected by sshd -t
failure_injection_coverage.F9: Missing operator proof prevents Stage 2 root lockdown
